claims.text: The source defines Wav2Lip: freeze an expert SyncNet discriminator (colour, residual, cosine plus binary-cross-entropy, 5-frame window, 91% on LRS2 vs LipGAN 56%) and penalise the generator with expert-sync loss plus L1 (weight 0.03) plus visual GAN loss (weight 0.07); generator trained on LRS2 only, batch 80, Adam 1e-4.

Reported numbers: LRS2/LRW/LRS3 random-audio pairs lip-sync distance 6.512/6.386/6.652 and confidence 7.490/7.789/7.887 vs real 7.012/6.931, 6.736/7.838, 6.956/7.592; ReSyncED dubbed/random/TTS preference for Wav2Lip+GAN 60.2%/64.5%/51.2%, combined over 90% vs unsynced.

limitations.text: Metric uses public SyncNet (different data); inherits SyncNet instability; talking-face only.
